sentence: I bought some gifts for some Australian friends of mine.
synonym: for a few Australian friends I have
synonymNote: 意思相同，都表示'我的几个澳大利亚朋友'

distractors.word: for some Australian family of mine
distractors.note: family指家人，不是朋友，意思不同

distractors.word: from some Australian friends of mine
distractors.note: from表示来源，不是表示对象，方向相反

distractors.word: for all Australian friends of mine
distractors.note: all表示全部，some只表示部分，数量不同
